item.title: Network Search Tool
item.description: Function Overview linkThe network search configuration tool is mainly used to configure the WiFi data stick (collector). Using the network search tool to send commands to the collector can modify the parameters of the collector Usage link1. Prerequisites linkThe PC using the network search tool must be in the same network as the collector, otherwise the collector will not be searched 2. Search for all collector devices in the current network link After opening the software, the network search tool will automatically find the gateway address of the current network as the search address by default.

item.title: Organizational Structure
item.description: Function Overview link 1. Member List link View all members under the current organization 1.1 Add Members link Add members to the selected organization Definition of the data permissions for new members: Only for oneself: Newly added members can only see data within their permissions People in the same organization: Newly added members can see data within their own authority, and can also see data within other members in the same organization People in the same organization & subordinate organizations: Newly added members can see data within their own authority, and can also see data within other members in the same organization and other members in subordinate organizations 1.

item.title: Overview
item.description: Solarhub Web Overview linkSolarhub Web provides comprehensive energy monitoring services such as photovoltaic, wind power, and energy storage, and provides professional and efficient comprehensive energy cloud monitoring platform services for medium and large power stations, equipment manufacturers, operation and maintenance providers, and household power station owners. Have a Solarhub account link Experience account: In order to facilitate you to quickly experience the functions of Solarhub, we have opened a customer experience account.

item.description: Select My in the menu bar at the bottom of the APP, and you can switch the access mode of the App in Switch perspective There are two access perspectives, professional consultant and end user Professional consultant: Use the APP as an equipment manufacturer or dealer, focusing on all power stations and equipment under the platform End user: Use the APP as a power station owner, focusing on my power station and equipment

item.title: Quick Start
item.description: Solarhub App Overview link1. Collector network configuration linkUse SolarhubApp to configure the collector network. When configuring the network, please ensure that the collector and the network configuration mobile phone are under the same 2.4Ghz WiFi. Note: During the operation, please allow the application to obtain Bluetooth, positioning, data and other permissions, and turn on Bluetooth, WiFi, and positioning services, otherwise it may cause device selection or network configuration failure. Click Add Device after Network Configuration, and add network configuration devices by scanning the QR code of the collector/manually entering the collector serial number.

item.title: Quick Start

item.description: 1. Check the collector signal light link2. Query server selection link Send AT+SERVERSELECT command to query the URL selected in the service area. The firmware after version 3.0 points to URL2 by default, which is the address of each gateway service. If the address is unclear, please contact us.

item.title: Data dashboard
item.description: Business use link As an operator or installer, you need to understand the classification quantity and equipment distribution of the power stations under your company. This page displays the total number of power stations and the number of various types of power stations in the platform Display the distribution of power stations in different regions on the map. The map can be scaled, and the distribution will be displayed in different dimensions according to the scaling ratio.

item.description: Go to “My” at the bottom of the APP and click Network Configuration to enter the network configuration interface and prepare for network configuration To configure the network, you need to turn on Bluetooth, connect to 2.4GhzWIFi, and authorize Bluetooth WiFi and other permissions to the APP, otherwise the network configuration may fail. Add a device in the upper right corner, add a device by scanning the code or manually entering the serial number If the device enters the network configuration state, it will appear to be checked.

item.title: Photovoltaic system
item.description: Overview of power station link The overview of the photovoltaic system power station includes four sections: real-time power, daily power, social benefits, and online power station. Real-time power: Summary display of the power and installed capacity of photovoltaic power stations under the current login user data permission in the photovoltaic system Daily power: Display the daily power, monthly power generation, annual power generation, and cumulative power generation of photovoltaic power stations under the current login user data permission Social benefits: The social benefits generated by the entire photovoltaic system under the current login user data permission, including tree species index, carbon dioxide emission reduction, and light bulb usage Online power stations: The number of online power stations and the total number of power stations under the current login user data permission Power station list link The power station list displays some information of all online, faulty, and offline power stations.

Real-time power: Summary display of battery system power and installed capacity under the data permission of the current logged-in user in the battery system Charge and discharge statistics: Display the daily charge, daily discharge, cumulative charge, and cumulative discharge of the photovoltaic power station under the data permission of the current logged-in user Social benefits: The social benefits generated by the entire photovoltaic system under the data permission of the current logged-in user, including tree species index, carbon dioxide emission reduction, and light bulb usage Online power station: The number of online power stations and the total number of power stations under the data permission of the current logged-in user Power station list linkThis is the same as the photovoltaic system, please refer to Power station list

item.title: Household Energy Storage
item.description: Overview of Power Plant link The overview of the power plant for household energy storage includes four sections: power generation, power grid, battery, and power consumption. Power generation: Display the power generation power, photovoltaic installed capacity, daily power generation, monthly power generation, annual power generation, and annual power generation of household energy storage power stations under the data permission of the current logged-in user Grid: Display the purchase and sale power of household energy storage power stations under the data permission of the current logged-in user Battery: Display the SOC, daily discharge, and daily charging of household energy storage power stations under the data permission of the current logged-in user Power consumption: Display the power consumption power, daily power consumption, monthly power consumption, annual power consumption, and total power consumption of household energy storage power stations under the data permission of the current logged-in user Power station list linkThis is the same as the photovoltaic system, please refer to Power station list
